title: Mizzou researchers uncover key insight into mini-stroke treatment
summary_en: New research finds lower-dose aspirin is more effective than higher doses in two-drug antiplatelet therapy, helping standardize treatment during the period when patients face the greatest risk of a major stroke.
title_cn: Mizzou researchers uncover key insight into mini-stroke treatment

title: As he turns 40, Truman picks up some age-appropriate hobbies and habits
summary_en: From lawn care to grilling, Mizzou’s beloved mascot celebrates a milestone birthday across the campus he calls home.
